posts.caption: Boston is far from perfect. But we aren’t perfect either. Maybe what matters is that Boston stores our imperfections and accepts them as its own, allowing us to grow in the same way it does. Maybe what matters is existing in a place whose weird little world feels like a match for your own. Seeing the city from all its levels and through the streets while walking or biking, helps us to appreciate the beauty that Boston has to offer. Come on a bike ride through Boston to see the city the way we do. #boston #citybiking #cafebiking

Thanks to @somervillebike for having us speak at Streetwise at @aeronautbrewing!!! Was a great time sharing the theory of change behind Boston Cafe Bikers, and to show everyone what we’ve been doing and why we’re doing it! We believe strongly in “cafe biking”, a model of biking that is frequent, fun, and functional. We aim build people’s confidence in city cycling and promote exploration of local businesses across the Boston metro area.

Still thinking about our Halloween Ride: What’s Scarier than Mass Ave?? Turns out Mass Ave should’ve been scared of cafe bikers 😤😤 Costumes absolutely slayed Thanks for Ba Le for being so welcoming and giving our riders free coffee after their scary ride, we’ll be coming to local businesses in Dorchester more, so let us know your favorite place in the comments!! @fitzforboston would love to have you on a ride to a District 3 local cafe 🧡🖤🧡🖤 Happy fall, Boston Cafe Bikers

Did you know that cafes are still open when it rains??? Don’t let Boston’s moody ass weather get the best of you, come on a ride and find a new local cafe, every single weekend. 25$ Bluebikes credit to anyone on a Bluebike :)

Name something more French than biking to a local bakery. Michette’s new location in Cambridge understood the assignment completely with ample biking parking and all the cute cycling art. This store is the poster child for showing how prioritizing bike parking and pedestrian access over car parking, leads to more foot traffic and more customers. This couldn’t have been a more perfect ride through the rain. Thanks for giving us free croissants and a discount, we’ll be coming back for sure to support this incredible local business :) #citybiking #cafebiking #cambridge #michette

Somerville’s new NEIGHBORWAY is thawing Mossland streets is open for two way bike traffic, and a dead end for cars. This simplifies the driving pattern around Elm St, and connects safe bike network between Beacon St to Inman square, Somerville Ave to Porter Square, Elm St to Davis, and Cedar St from the Community Path. We love you @somervillecity #citybiking #somerville

NOVEMBER RIDES ARE OUT!!! Come with us to explore 6 different cafes this month in the Boston area! We’ll be hitting @michettebakery @gracenoteboston @butternutbakehouse @3littlefigscafe and more. As always, all rides start at a BlueBike station and if you ARE using a BlueBike, we’ll give you 25$ in credit 🤩🤩 @ridebluebikes Love what we’re doing and wanna help out? We’re looking for people to lead rides, take and make social media content, and help with the website and data analysis!

Our brewery rides CONTINUE INTO THE FALL 🍁 Each month we’ll feature a different brewery for our Boston Brewery Meetups, they’ll always be on Tuesday evenings!! This month we’ll be going to Notch Brewing Company in Brighton, at the Speedway @notchbrewing Come hang after work, meet some people, unwind and don’t let daylight savings get the best of ya :)
